name: ob1-auth-poc
comment: The authorization-server POC's container side (SMD-2285): oidc-provider is pinned EXACTLY, because its experimental features (CIMD, ack draft-02) take breaking changes in minor releases and its grants helpers are outside semver — a bump is a PR that runs `eval-auth.ts --verify`. Better Auth and its two plugins (the runner-up) are pinned exactly as well, for its 2026 advisory record. The MCP packages match server-portable's (SMD-2278).
